lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A cluster of approximately 15-20 high-luminance circular points is visible posterior to the final gill slit, arranged in a semi-regular grid with three primary horizontal rows and four vertical columns visible within the frame.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are observed intersecting with the lateral blobs, particularly evident in the region immediately posterior to the pectoral fin attachment.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running along the dorsal-lateral flank, defined by a sharp intensity transition from high-luminance upper edges to shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) located ventrally, just below the branchial region and anterior to the pectoral fin.
